newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares close firm, mood optimistic.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares close firm, mood optimistic.

text.p: LISBON, April 15 (Reuter) Shares closed firmer with traders s eeing the optimism spilling over into Wednesday as Wall Street advanced and the stronger dollar encouraged foreign buying of the Portuguese market.
*The PSI20 index ended 1.11 percent higher at 6,128.21, with futures gaining in line.
*Portugal Telecom drew strong interest after announcing its link-up with Telefonica, while the banking sector also made ground.
*Salomon Brothers has issued a report recommending Portuguese banks and putting out a "strong buy" on Banco Comercial Portugues, Banco Portugues de Investimento and Banco Totta.
*Traders said news that mobile phone operator Telecel's first quarter profit doubled to some three billion escudos should help its stock on Wednesday.
*"The results are very good and the paper is going to have to rise," said one trader, referring to Telecel.
*Totta closed 1.44 percent higher with investors attracted by the dividend yield, with the dividend to be distributed on April 24.
